column1: # dispatch-runtime-executables.tsv -- DGN-1673: dispatch runtime -> the local
# CLI executable it spawns. DATA, not logic. routines/cli-updater.py reads it
# to derive the nightly CLI watch set: every distinct runtime in
# dispatch-tier-bindings.tsv is looked up here, so a runtime cannot start
# being used without its binary entering the watch set. A runtime that is in
# the tier table but has NO row here is reported (alert), never silently
# skipped.
# Why a SIBLING file and not a 5th column on dispatch-tier-bindings.tsv: same
# reason as dispatch-effort-bindings.tsv -- the tier table is keyed
# (runtime, axis), the executable is a property of the runtime alone, and the
# gate's parser of the tier table is not to be touched by this ticket.
# Columns (TAB-separated): runtime  executable  evidence
#   executable = bare command name dispatch-detached.sh invokes via PATH.
#                The install class (claude-native / codex-standalone / other)
#                is NOT declared here: cli-updater.py classifies it from the
#                realpath at run time, so a re-install under another method
#                cannot leave a stale class in this file.
